title: Arc ledger

reference.source: Reference 26: a two-deck concentric arc chart on a ring-ruled paper, 1486×842.
reference.note: held locally; this page carries statistics measured from it and none of its pixels

summary: Two mirrored decks of ten track arcs on a paper ruled with 6.25 px concentric rings; each arc sweeps by its value from a numbered cap, and its empty track runs on as the leader to a label set tangent to it.
units: reference pixels; the plate is 1486 × 842 and every length scales with the canvas

text.dataA: Helix open / 140%; Second brain / 129%; Gut signal / 105%; Mir replies / 76%; Loop closes / 72%; Little robot / 50%; Night mode / 35%; Slow morning / 30%; Quiet check / 30%; First thought / 12%
text.dataB: Helix turn / 444%; Deep listen / 340%; Gut answer / 330%; Robot wakes / 318%; Mir remembers / 195%; Thread held / 135%; Signal clears / 110%; Pause / 39%; Breath / 32%; First thought / 2%

pitch.does: Radial distance from one track to the next; the arc width follows it.

hair.does: Paper-colored outline around every arc; the gap you see between neighbors.

guide.does: The empty track's edge line from arc end to label. 0 removes the leaders.

gap.does: Space from cap to leader, and how far the label starts back from the axis

minSweep.does: Sweep given to a value of zero, so every arc shows its cap and numeral.

maxSweep.does: Sweep of the largest value; clamped so no arc runs into its own label.

rampBend.does: How the ten greens are spaced from outer (light) to inner (dark).

labelCap.does: Size of the tangent labels; longer labels take more of the track.

numeralCap.does: Size of the white numerals in the start caps.

labelDrop.does: Extra radial offset of the label from its leader; 0 is the measured seat.

typeSoft.does: Resample blur on the arcs, leaders and type, as the reference carries; 0 is crisp vector.

titleR.does: Radius of the title from its group center, in the quiet sector before the caps.

ringsPer.does: Fine ring count inside one track pitch; the ruling that reads as paper texture.

ringDepth.does: Darkness of each fine ring at its center.

ringWidth.does: Softness of the fine rings; large values blur them into a tone.

bead.does: How unevenly each ring takes ink along its length; 0 is a perfectly even line.

halfRing.does: Depth of the fainter ring the reference carries between each pair of rings.

mottle.does: Low-amplitude paper noise under the rings.

axis.does: Tilt of the diagonal that the caps, the label starts and the ring seam all sit on.

spread.does: How far the two group centers sit from the plate center.

phase.does: Position along the loop: the ruling moves outward by one ring pitch per cycle.

modes.saw: value up to value + amp over period seconds, then again
modes.drift: seeded walk, one step of up to amp every period seconds, folded back at the slider ends

motion.runs: only while Motion is on, at half scale; the sliders hold the center values; off by default

live.runs: only while Live is on: a drag on the figure sets x across and y down between these ends; off by default

techniques.name: Edge
techniques.implementation: Start cap of the upper deck: a white Archivo 700 numeral centered in a 14.25 px round cap, with the 1 px paper outline between it and the next track.

techniques.name: Pull
techniques.implementation: Ten stacked tracks: 29.5 px ink, 1.4 px paper hairline, ten greens from (221,232,152) outward to (0,87,66) inward.

techniques.name: Grain
techniques.implementation: Bare ruling: rings at 6.25 px pitch, a gaussian dip of 26/255 with σ 0.6 px and a 6/255 half-pitch ring between, under 3.3/255 of grain.

techniques.name: Type
techniques.implementation: Labels on their tracks: straight, tangent at the midpoint, Archivo 400 name and 700 value, cap tops 1.5 px off the leader, softened by 0.45 px σ.

pass_order: pass 1, paper: a flat near-white, then two concentric ring systems (one per group center) meeting on the axis diagonal; each fine ring is a gaussian dip of measured depth with a fainter ring between each pair, five rings per track pitch; a low-amplitude grain, part high-passed, under it
pass 2, leaders: each empty track's inner edge is drawn as a 1 px gray arc from the arc's end cap to the label's near end
pass 3, arcs: a paper-white outline stroke, then the ink stroke, round caps; the outline is the hairline you see between neighbors
pass 4, numerals: white bold figures centered in the start caps

pass 5, labels: name (Archivo 400) and value (700) set on one straight baseline tangent to the track at the label's midpoint, cap tops toward the leader, flipped to stay readable on the mirrored group
pass 6, titles: two upright lines in the quiet sector before the caps

pass 7, softening: the drawn layer (arcs, leaders, numerals, labels, titles) is blurred by 0.45 px σ and composited over the paper, the resample softening the reference carries; the paper keeps its own grain

measured.plate: 1486×842; group A center (870.3, 487.4) by least-squares circle fit on the outer arc edge; group B is its 180° rotation about the plate center (615.7, 354.6)
measured.tracks: pitch 31.25 px (radial profile: hairlines at 162.5, 193.75, … 412.5 from the center; autocorrelation peak at 31.25); innermost track inner edge 131.25 px (= 21 fine rings); outermost edge 443.75; ink width 29.5 px, white hairline 1.75 px
measured.arcs: caps centered on the axis at −135° from the group center (numeral centers measured at −135.1°); ends measured for A: 15.5, 4, −24, −36, −42, −70, −77.5, −77.5, −95.5, ≈−99° → sweeps 150…36°; fit as sweep = 30° + 0.85°/% (ref values 12…140 %); the reference's B group is not proportional (444 % at 141°), so proportional sweep is the engine's rule, not the reference's
measured.paper: between rings (250,249,247) (top decile 252,251,250); fine ring pitch 6.25 px (autocorrelation peak 6.25 with harmonic at 31.25); folded radial profile at 0.125 px: dip 247 → 229, FWHM 2.1 px, plus a 3/255 dip midway between rings → gaussian σ 0.6 depth 26 with a 6/255 half-pitch ring; corner patch decomposed into ring model σ 7.3 and residual noise σ 4.1 with lag-1 x-autocorrelation −0.23 → grain 30 % high-passed; whole-plate green share 26.2 %
measured.ringSeam: local structure-tensor orientation of the paper fits center A on one side and center B on the other of a line through the plate center at ≈43–45°
measured.leaders: 1 px dark gray (≈80) at the track's inner edge, present only from arc end to label; no guide circles past the labels (checked at 60°, 100°)
measured.labels: straight lines tangent to the track; glyph normal extents inner edge +2 … +21 px (cap tops almost touching the leader, baseline near the track center); label starts aligned on the +45° axis (max angle 44.7° on every track); text ink (40,37,36)
measured.type: label cap height ≈ 13 px, value bold; numerals ≈ 13.5 px white serif bold (Archivo 700 stands in); title two lines, cap 12 px, pitch 19 px, centered at r 294 / −157° from the group center

benchmark.computed: live, when this page loads, by the code that measured the reference: default parameters, Ledger green palette, 1× reference size

setup.note: The benchmark feeds the reference's own country list and titles so the typed patches compare the same words; the composition is laid out by the engine's rules, so patches are the same rects on both.

limits: The reference's numerals are a serif bold; Archivo 700 stands in, which keeps the arc-starts histogram near 0.97.

The reference's ruling and type are resampled, so a 0.45 px σ blur is applied to the drawn layer (arcs, leaders, type) and the fine ruling carries a 6/255 half-pitch ring measured in the folded radial profile; the paper patch's histogram and spectrum sit near 0.96 to 0.98.
The reference's hairline reads as a 1.4 px paper line after softening, wider than the 1 px core measured on the raw profile; the arc-field paper (hairline) color sits near 0.92.
The reference's lower deck is not proportional to its values (444 % at 158°, 2 % at 13°); the engine is, with a 32° floor, so whole-plate shares differ by about a point.
notes: Deterministic: the same palette, parameters and seed give the same pixels.
A display render is capped at 2.4 megapixels; a slider in motion draws at half scale (down to a quarter on a heavy engine) and the release redraws in full.
